description: Core API models for admin panel including authentication tokens, user, book, category, pagination, and analytics summaries.

classes.name: AuthTokens
classes.description: Represents authentication tokens including access, refresh tokens, and token type.

classes.name: AdminUser
classes.description: Represents an administrator user with identification and status information.

classes.name: BookModel
classes.description: Represents a book with metadata such as title, author, description, category, and ratings.

classes.name: CategorySummary
classes.description: Provides a summarized view of a category with id, name, and optional slug.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Represents a detailed category with id, name, and optional slug.

classes.name: PageMeta
classes.description: Contains pagination metadata including current page, page size, total items, and total pages.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: Summary statistics for analytics such as total books, users, orders, and sales.

methods.description: Creates an AuthTokens instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: AuthTokens.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the AuthTokens instance into a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates an AdminUser instance from a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates a BookModel instance from a JSON object.

methods.description: Creates a PageMeta instance from a JSON object.
